name: 24014 · Roanoke, VA
findings: ZIP 24014 (Roanoke) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24014 (Roanoke) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24014 (Roanoke) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 24014 (Roanoke) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
